name: building-with-zep
description: Build and configure applications that use Zep — agent memory built on temporal Context Graphs. Bundles the building-with-zep skill (how to reason about and build on Zep), the tuning-zep-ingestion skill (how to ingest a dataset and tune the extraction), the migrating-zep-v3-to-v4 skill (how to migrate applications from V3 to V4), and the Zep documentation MCP server (real-time docs search).
